scope: One explicit offline pair of already completed private periodic trajectories. No solver, raw-BI4 reader process, build, input mutation, GPU wall, public gravity or physical admission.
reuse: Import only the existing side-effect-free module upl_gravity_periodic_compare_r1.py under a non-main name. Reuse neutral binary/table/entry/rms_vector/FIELDS, constants and binding utilities; never call its hardcoded CPU proof/load/main. Its exact source/note and prior admission note are hash-bound as inputs.
CLI: python tests/support/upl_gpu_gravity_periodic_pair_r1.py --pair half|frame_c|frame_h|cross_c|cross_h --model constant|variable --a NEW_GPU_REVIEW --a-check NEW_GPU_CHECK --b MATCHED_REVIEW --b-check MATCHED_CHECK --out tests/logs/FRESH_TAG [--figure]

eight_independent_pairs.half: For each of constant/variable: new GPU coarse versus new GPU half, in their saved accelerating frames.
eight_independent_pairs.frame_c_frame_h: For each model and each dt: new GPU gravity accelerating frame versus the corresponding retained upl_gpu_perm_actual_GPU_{constant,variable}_{c,h}_r1 private g0 review/control. Old controls are read,never rerun.
eight_independent_pairs.cross_c_cross_h: Variable only: new GPU gravity versus retained upl_gravity_periodic_cpu_ReleaseCPU_{c,h}_r1 nong0 private variable trajectory, using the same declared accelerating frame. No retained nong0 constant CPU trajectory exists; constant cross is rejected. This is not timing/benchmark evidence.

schema: Exactly257 actual saved times part*2^-23 through2^-15,512 native IDs0..511 and33 common columns. Coarse dt2^-24,half2^-25; initial saved Step0 and later2part-1 or4part-1. Native signed dterror finite and <=1e-14,not an absolute-error test. Report every33 field in both compared accelerating coordinates and original inertial coordinates,including binary64 mismatch-node counts. No columns are omitted or masked.

predeclared_limits.all_samples: Pressure RMS<=5Pa,maximum XYZ material displacement difference<=0.005mm,plus independent p/Pstar,XYZ v/A and XYZ material-u/Ustar RMS each<=1e-4. Material-u difference must agree with position difference within original32DBL_EPS absolute roundoff consistency screen.
predeclared_limits.law: Constant current k=double(float(1e-4)); variable k=k0*exp((J-1)/((1-n0)*Ck)),n0=.25,Ck2^-13. V/rho/k remain derived from native J on every private side,not newly native arrays or material calibration.
predeclared_limits.single_safety: Independently retain J>.75,|J-1|<=1e-4,0<n<1,actual n/V/rho/k and solid-volume identity relative5e-13,finite/excess/passive-rho/plastic/load guards,frame energy/E0<=1.1,current-J acoustic CFL/current-k diffusion<=.01 and strict RH margin>64DBL_EPS*max(rho,rhow). These saved-point checks are necessary screens,not sufficient stability or all-force-stage observations.
predeclared_limits.body_g: Only frame_c/frame_h pairs have an independent g0 reference. At each native sample require fullXYZ RMS(v_g-v_g0-g*t)/A<=1e-4. No unweighted center-of-mass conservation assumption. At the last frame,omit or double g*t in the comparison formula only; both residuals must exceed100 original A*1e-4 budgets. No deliberately wrong solver is launched.
predeclared_limits.descriptive_only: Theta,stress,J/n/derivedVrhoK,FSType and FSnormal differences are fully reported but acquire no new fitted per-column acceptance threshold. Bounded p/v/u agreement is not all33 equivalence or a continuum/theory assertion.

outputs: Fresh logs/TAG.check.json plus shallow figures/TAG.csv (257 rows),TAG_fields.csv (8481 rows) and optionalTAG.png. Fresh-path rejection,no overwrites. Plot shows normalized p/v/u in ppm with linear autoscale and textual prior100ppm; no smoothing,interpolation,screening or forced100ppm axis. JSON scalars are explicitly Python bool/int/float to avoid retired numpy-bool serialization failure.
preservation: No source/project/formal/server/canonical change. No old solver,public switch,gravity wall,traction,hydrostatic or full-cycle claim. An analysis failure preserves completed trajectories and partial analysis files; any repair must use a new output label,not rerun physics or overwrite evidence.
